latest_release.name: Fix the enum values of env:add
latest_release.body:
## [7.7.1](https://github.com/adonisjs/core/compare/v7.7.0...v7.7.1) (2026-11-27)

### Bug fixes

- `node ace env:add --type=enum` writes a rule that accepts the value. With no `--enum-values`, it asks for the values. To give the values as flags, repeat the flag for each value: `--enum-values=debug --enum-values=info`. Before, the command never asked, and a comma-separated list became one value, so the app did not boot. ([#5177](https://github.com/adonisjs/core/pull/5177), closes [#5176](https://github.com/adonisjs/core/issues/5176))
- The string helpers import the named exports of `he` 2, which has no default export. ([#5181](https://github.com/adonisjs/core/pull/5181))

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/adonisjs/core/compare/v7.7.0...v7.7.1
